The Backlog Is Not the Quarter

mentions.excerpt: Edelbridge Alpha sees the town hall rather than the substation.
Edelbridge Alpha counts 26 US data-center projects blocked in the first quarter of 2026, against 31 in all of 2025, with another 49 delayed and 166 facing some form of opposition.

Edelbridge Alpha's September 22 model for Lumentum assumes $11.1 billion of fiscal 2028 revenue against consensus near $9.6 billion, a number that requires optical circuit switches to scale quickly and current product lines to stay supply-constrained; Edelbridge still passes at current prices, because the target also needs sustained pricing power.
